scope: Independent manual native-simulator protocols, not full configuration/runtime parity or a pre-registered study. Expectations come from the public Energy Manager knowledge base; zero-power semantics are an observational question. Execution records must remain separate.
safety: Only owned official Config GUI and disconnected disposable copies of the public heating-rod sample. Testing > Start Simulation is distinct from disabled LIVE and Connect to Miniserver. Never connect, transfer, deploy, invoke lox live, alter the host clock, or use lox sim as an independent oracle.
preparation: Use ConfigEditor/CLI-owned valid changes, exact inspected source connector UUIDs, and native GUI load editing. Retain twelve original Load records, their Id/OIdx and original output wires. Native digit-prefixed attributes must not pass through a competing XML sanitizer.

controls.load_L1: Original connected digital L1; rated/switch-on power 2.5 kW, preparation RT=30 s, MinRt=0.
controls.other_loads: Original connected L2/L3 retained but rated/switch-on power zero to isolate L1. Nine originally unused slots remain unused.
controls.storage_feedback: IL1/IL2/IL3 explicitly wired to zero (reported OFF), not unconnected automatic load-demand feedback. Static grid/production inputs model a pre-allocation state, not a closed physical plant.
controls.daily_feedback: IL1 wired to OL1. A native Mult computes Gpwr=2.5*OL1, giving grid0 when off and import2.5 when on. Ppwr=Spwr=0, Soc=100, MinSoc=MaxSpwr=0. Other feedback inputs remain zero. No physical actuator is operated.
controls.time: Only the official simulator's Use current time/date/time/pause/resume controls. Record actual readbacks and output snapshots. Internal simulation dt is not exposed; wall waits only allow native calculations to run. A paused date jump is not continuous 24-hour integration.
controls.sampling: Storage: run beyond the initial 60-second countdown, e.g. 70 s. Daily: start simulated 10:58:00, sample near +5,+70,+150 s. Screenshot capture adds overhead; record actual displayed times rather than treating nominal waits as exact.

cases.condition: Disconnected official public-sample copy, LIVE disabled, separate Start Simulation enabled.
cases.procedure: Capture the Testing ribbon before starting; click Start Simulation only; observe block values and Next countdown, then stop.
cases.expected: Owned official offline simulator executes EnergyManager2 with changing runtime state/countdown without a Miniserver connection.

cases.condition: Gpwr=-4, Ppwr=4, Spwr=0, Soc=49, MinSoc=50, MaxSpwr=3; MDay=0.
cases.procedure: Start a fresh native simulation of this static pre-allocation state; record inputs and L1 after the first calculation interval.
cases.expected: Charging priority leaves insufficient surplus for the 2.5 kW digital L1; compare OFF with the otherwise identical at-threshold case.

cases.condition: Same as below-finite except Soc=50, exactly MinSoc.
cases.procedure: Start a fresh native simulation; record actual Soc, parameter values and L1 after the first calculation interval.
cases.expected: Storage priority no longer withholds the finite charging allocation and L1 can turn ON with 4 kW export.

cases.procedure: Observe L1 in a fresh native simulation after the first calculation interval and capture any native configuration feedback.
cases.expected: Obtain the actual output and any warning; discriminate from finite MaxSpwr without presupposing zero means unlimited charging or disabled storage.

cases.condition: A general interpretation of zero across charging/discharging, connected storage and configuration validation.
cases.procedure: Only claim a universal meaning after an independently reviewed, valid and discriminating runtime batch; otherwise retain not_run.
cases.expected: One state, especially one with native incomplete-configuration feedback, does not establish a universal zero-power semantic.

cases.condition: Closed daily-feedback plant, MDay=60 s, deadline 11:00 (tpR=14), no PV surplus.
cases.procedure: Select 11:00 in the official load dialog and save. Start simulator-local date/time at 2026-11-05 10:58:00. Sample before the daily window, during activation and after the deadline; capture actual grid, load feedback and L1.
cases.expected: Native daily-minimum scheduling activates L1 despite no surplus and later releases it. Sampling bounds transitions; it does not prove exact one-second deadline accuracy.

cases.condition: Same native simulation has already completed the first daily minimum and switched L1 off.
cases.procedure: Pause, use the official simulator calendar to select 2026-11-06 and simulator time 10:58:00, then resume without stop/start, reopening or reload. Sample off/on/off around the second day's 11:00 deadline.
cases.expected: The same native runtime rearms the daily load on the next simulated date. State the explicit clock jump; do not describe it as a continuously integrated 24-hour cycle.

cases.condition: First activation of a fresh native runtime occurs after its daily deadline.
cases.procedure: In a separately bounded batch, start the closed daily-feedback plant after 11:00 and record activation and release; otherwise retain not_run.
cases.expected: The public KB describes immediate activation, but metadata and the before-deadline cases cannot substitute for executing this condition.

cases.condition: Continuous native integration across an entire day without a calendar jump or restart.
cases.procedure: Requires a separately authorized bounded native time-acceleration method or full-duration manual run. Do not change the host clock or create recurring jobs.
cases.expected: Keep not_run unless every intervening interval is genuinely exercised by the native simulator; host wall-time passage or a paused calendar jump is insufficient.
